entries.2c0ea845346aeadd: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,322,791 million (up 19.4% year on year). The System Integration Business recorded ¥902,915 million (up 24.1% year on year), with PCs posting strong growth as they captured replacement demand and packaged software also growing strongly. The Service & Support Business recorded ¥419,875 million (up 10.5% year on year). For product sales, revenue is recognized when control passes to the customer (for domestic transactions shipped from a distribution center, at the time of shipment). For contracted software development, revenue is recognized for each of the 4 phases from requirements definition through migration, and for maintenance and similar services it is recognized over a set period depending on the contract. For some transactions in which other parties provide services, such as copier maintenance and telecommunications, revenue is recognized on a net basis as an agent.
entries.389aff699ca89460: This business covers support after system launch, and provides comprehensive support for installed systems and corporate activities through office supply provision, hardware and software maintenance, telephone support, outsourcing services and more. Centered on the mail-order service “Tanomēru” and the support service “Tayorēru,” the company focuses on stock businesses that generate recurring revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥419,875 million (up 10.5% year on year). The partial change in classification method and the year-on-year calculation are the same as for the System Integration Business.
entries.4ea8be7a27a96f53: It conducts business on two pillars: the System Integration Business, which covers everything from system construction to operation, and the Service & Support Business, which supports customers after operation through maintenance and the supply of office supplies.
entries.4f4759f713e9f713: The group consists of the company, 8 subsidiaries (of which 4 are consolidated subsidiaries) and 6 affiliates (of which 3 are equity-method companies), 15 companies in total. Its main businesses are the System Integration Business, whose scope runs through building and putting systems into operation, and the Service & Support Business, whose scope is support after systems go live. The consolidated subsidiaries OSK, Networld, Alpha Techno and Alpha Net each handle 2 businesses, and are connected with the company through commissioned software development, purchases of network-related products, and commissioned repair of PC peripherals and support of network systems (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.51bfd347e24d196a: The number of trading companies in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 311,000 (up 5.4% year on year). No single customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue, and revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue. Points of contact with customers are 3 channels: “Real,” “Web” and “Center,” and the company also uses the customer portal site “Customer My Page.”
entries.58e30656741971ad: Revenue from external customers of the Service & Support Business (¥419,875 million for the same period)
entries.5b07f2f1b095fc62: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥64,303 million (up 20.2% year on year), with profit rising on higher revenue. Both revenue and net income have reached record highs for 3 consecutive years. The accounting standards are Japanese standards (Japan GAAP).

entries.603b06c16527cdf6: It is a business brand that supports customers' information systems and overall corporate activities, and is another 1 of the stock businesses that the Service & Support Business focuses on.
entries.63cdc267a8989b6e: This business covers the construction and operation of information systems, providing customers with systems tailored to their needs, from consulting through system design and development, equipment delivery and installation work, to network construction. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥902,915 million (up 24.1% year on year), the larger of the two reportable segments. In this period, personal computers captured replacement demand and grew strongly, and packaged software also grew strongly. In addition, from this period the company revised part of the performance management categories of its consolidated subsidiaries and partly changed the method of classifying the two businesses. Year-on-year comparisons are calculated by restating the prior-year figures under the new categories, and the filing states that the effect is minor.
entries.68804c8c7ead6704: By organizing its 3 customer touchpoints, “Real,” “Web” and “Center,” and providing solutions that link and integrate real business and Web business, the company aims to be a partner entrusted with “Office Marugoto.” In the System Integration Business it will focus on value-added proposals that leverage the strength of the group as a whole, and in the Service & Support Business it will focus on recurring-revenue business centered on “Tanomeru” and “Tayoreru,” and says it will strive to improve profitability. For fiscal 2026, under the slogan “Growing alongside customers with AI and security,” the company plans to propose AI solutions and security measures that can be introduced at affordable prices for mid-sized and small business customers.
